svg.text: DCA against hindsight (God): VAS, $500 a month
2013-01-02 to 2025-11-28. Dip-buyer: hindsight. $3 brokerage, whole units, cash waits in AAA. Historical scenario, not a forecast.
DCA: buy on the day the money arrives
189 buys, $567 brokerage, $27 cash left at the end, $62,687 gained
God: buys the lowest close between two all-time highs (hindsight)
81 buys, $243 brokerage, $563 cash left at the end, $63,545 gained
Brokerage paid so far (its own scale: too small for the panels above)
Dip-buyer's value minus DCA's value (own scale: above zero = dip-buyer ahead)
